name.ja: HGBF 1/144 ガーベラ・テトラ（キララ専用機）

description.ja: ガンプラアイドル キララの使用機体がＨＧに！
description.en: Gunpla idol Kirara's aircraft is now HG!

description.ja: 『ガンダムビルドファイターズ』より、ガンプラアイドル キララの使用機体、ガーベラ・テトラ（キララ専用機）を、ＨＧシリーズで商品化。
description.en: From "Gundam Build Fighters", Gunpla idol Kirara's aircraft, Gerbera Tetra (Kirara's exclusive aircraft), has been commercialized in the HG series.

description.ja: 劇中にあわせたピンク系の成形色を採用！特徴的なツノの付いた頭部パーツは新規造形で再現！
description.en: Adopts a pink molding color that matches the movie! The head parts with characteristic horns are reproduced with new modeling!

description.ja: ●　ツノが付いた頭部パーツを新規造形で再現！
description.en: ● Reproduce the head part with horns with new modeling!

description.ja: 特徴的なツノが付いた頭部パーツは新規造形。パーツの選択で、番組前半登場時の頭部も再現可能。
description.en: The head parts with distinctive horns are newly sculpted. By selecting parts, you can also recreate the head when it appeared in the first half of the program.

description.ja: ●　劇中にあわせたピンク系の成形色を採用！
description.en: ● Adopts a pink molding color that matches the movie!

description.ja: ●　シュツルム・ブースター装備時と非装備時の両方の形態を再現可能！
description.en: ● Both forms can be reproduced with and without the Sturm booster equipped!

description.ja: ●　ＨＧＢＦ フェニーチェリナーシタ用ほっぺホイルシールが付属！
description.en: ● Comes with cheek foil seal for HGBF Fenice Rinasita!

description.ja: 付属武装 ： ビームマシンガン ／ ビームサーベル
description.en: Attached weapons: Beam machine gun/beam saber
